Thailand: School shooting and lightning strike incidents reported

A student opened fire at a high school in Thailand's Nonthaburi province on Friday, resulting in multiple casualties. Reports indicate that seven people were killed and 15 were injured in the school shooting. Among the deceased was a teacher, and the injured included students. The student who carried out the shooting also died. Separately, a 24-year-old footballer was killed by a lightning strike during a match in southern Thailand.
